about.heading: Who I am
about.summary: I'm a software engineer with 3.5+ years of industry experience building backend and full-stack applications for enterprise telecommunications and logistics platforms. My focus is Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, PostgreSQL, Redis, React and TypeScript. I have worked on systems serving millions of users, improved API performance, built secure OAuth2/JWT APIs, and delivered cloud-ready deployments with Docker, Jenkins and AWS. I am pursuing an M.Sc. in Applied Computer Science at Hochschule Schmalkalden and am interested in Werkstudent and part-time software engineering opportunities.

skills.heading: What I work with
skills.subheading: Tools and technologies I use to design, build and ship backend systems.

bullets: Architected scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices for a telecom platform serving 5M+ subscribers, maintaining high availability under production load.
Reduced API response time from ~800ms to ~150ms with Redis distributed caching and by eliminating N+1 JPA query patterns — a 5× latency improvement.
Built and maintained REST APIs integrated with 6+ third-party systems, cutting integration failure points by 30% through structured error handling and retry logic.
Implemented OAuth2 + JWT authentication, RBAC and audit logging to secure multi-tenant access across a distributed microservices backend.
Containerised services with Docker and automated deployments through Jenkins CI/CD, reducing the release cycle by ~25%.
Developed live-subscriber KPI dashboards with Angular 12 and HighCharts.js, and mentored 2 junior engineers in architecture, code review and debugging.
Shipped independent backend features within three months of joining and contributed to decomposing a legacy monolith into independently deployable Spring Boot microservices.
Optimised 15+ complex PostgreSQL queries and stored procedures, reducing average query execution time by up to 40%.
Wrote JUnit 5 unit and integration tests to improve coverage for critical payment-processing modules.
Containerised services with Docker and contributed to Jenkins deployment workflows for the microservices migration initiative.
Developed and maintained Java and Spring Boot enterprise logistics and cargo revenue accounting modules for aviation clients handling high-volume financial transactions.
Reduced production issue resolution time by ~25% through systematic Linux log analysis and SQL profiling across Java-based banking and IT systems.
Contributed to Jenkins CI/CD improvements that reduced manual deployment steps and team friction.
Built REST API endpoints and backend modules, shipped features independently, and supported bug fixes with JUnit tests.
Built REST API endpoints and backend modules under mentorship in a Java and Spring Boot enterprise environment.
Contributed to bug fixes and JUnit tests across Java applications for banking and IT clients.
Analysed production issues and supported debugging, building systematic log-reading and SQL-profiling skills.

items.description: Contributing to an open-source, full-stack community platform for Hochschule Schmalkalden students, supporting event registration, post creation, commenting and community engagement. Building component-driven React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS features; integrating Supabase for real-time data, authentication and storage, with Prisma managing schema and migrations. Collaborating through structured Git commits, feature work, bug fixes and UI improvements.

items.title: Air Quality Index Prediction
items.subtitle: KNSIT Bangalore
items.description: Built and compared Linear Regression, Random Forest, Ridge/Lasso and XGBoost models to predict Air Quality Index values from environmental sensor data. Developed a Python web scraper for real-world data, performed feature analysis and model evaluation, then deployed the best-performing model with a frontend interface on Heroku.
